patterns.note: A fixed-width left sidebar navigation is present on all pages, while the main content area occupies the remaining width and scrolls independently.
The main content area is a dense, borderless grid of square or rectangular project thumbnails, packed tightly without visible gutters.

The primary content area, a grid of diverse 3D project examples, scrolls vertically without any individual item animations, reveals, or parallax effects as elements enter or exit the viewport. The left navigation remains static.
The site's UI uses a stark, minimal palette of white and dark grey, providing a neutral canvas for the extremely vibrant and diverse colors within the showcased 3D projects.

technique_notes: The site uses a two-column layout where the left column is a fixed-position navigation sidebar that does not scroll, and the right column is the main content area that scrolls vertically. The content within the main area is presented as a grid of static image previews, which simply scroll into and out of view without any additional scroll-triggered animations or transitions. The detected webgl-three technology likely refers to the interactive nature of the individual project examples when clicked, rather than the scroll behavior of the gallery itself.

design_tokens.type_scale: A relatively flat type scale with small, clean sans-serif text for navigation and body, and slightly larger, bolded sans-serif for section headings.
design_tokens.spacing: very dense for the content grid, balanced for the sidebar navigation links

standout: The most distinctive feature is the overwhelming, dense grid of diverse and visually rich 3D project examples. This acts as a powerful, direct demonstration of the underlying technology's capabilities, making the site itself a living portfolio of its own potential.
